description: A constrained study: S=2, N=4. Every block holds the 2 intervals (m-1, m+1), so count=2, sum=2m, m2=2, and the ranking statistic of a one-block half is m/sqrt(2). Block means (block 0, block 1): trial 0 = (4, 1), trial 1 = (2, 3), trial 2 = (1, 2), all with status ok, and trial 3 = (5, 4) with status constraint_violation. Trial 3 is the training winner of both splits, so leaving it out changes every count. Hand count in tests/python/test_pbo.py.
